mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS id, a.name AS name, a.rule AS rule, a.version AS version, a.status AS status, a.created_by AS createdBy, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.updated_at AS updatedAt, ls.id AS latestSnapshotId, ls.status AS latestSnapshotStatus, ls.member_count AS latestSnapshotMemberCount, ls.executed_at AS latestSnapshotExecutedAt FROM audience a LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.id, s.status, s.member_count, s.executed_at FROM audience_snapshot s WHERE s.audience_id = a.id AND s.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY s.executed_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) ls ON TRUE WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC
